def.zh-tw: 光子、電子等微觀粒子同時具有波動性與粒子性：傳播時會像波一樣干涉、繞射，被偵測時卻一顆一顆地出現。
def.en: Photons, electrons and other microscopic particles behave both as waves and as particles: they interfere and diffract like waves as they travel, yet are detected one at a time like particles.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下物理學名詞：波粒二象性 wave-particle duality

def.zh-tw: 波通過兩條靠得很近的狹縫後，兩道波在屏幕上疊加，形成明暗相間的條紋；這是波動性的標誌。
def.en: When a wave passes through two narrow, closely spaced slits, the two waves overlap on the screen and form alternating bright and dark fringes; this is the signature of a wave.

source.locator: 108課綱 自然領綱 PKd-Ⅴc-5（示範實驗：雙狹縫干涉）
